evals.name: 01-write-skill
evals.prompt: Write a skill for this repo that walks the agent through a release: bump the version, update CHANGELOG.md, tag the merge, and open the pull request into main.
assertions: [1] The run started 3 fresh reviewer subagents: loading, ASD-STE100, and ISO 24495-1.
[2] Each reviewer finding names its rule and quotes the text.
[3] After the reviews, the run did a reader test with 3 dry-run subagents: 2 typical tasks and 1 near-miss task. No reader subagent wrote a file.
[4] The run did a maximum of 3 review rounds and a maximum of 3 reader-test rounds.
[5] The report says that word choice was checked from model knowledge, not against the ASD-STE100 dictionary.
[6] The new or changed text has no "should", "may", "ensure", or "begin". It has no semicolons, contractions, Latin abbreviations, or emphasis words such as "IMPORTANT" or "CRITICAL".
[7] In the new or changed text, each imperative sentence has a maximum of 20 words. Each other sentence has a maximum of 25 words.
[8] Each new pointer is a prose sentence that states when to read its target. The new text has no `@path`, except `@AGENTS.md` in `CLAUDE.md`.
[9] The new text uses each `CONTEXT.md` term with its glossary meaning and uses no synonym for it.
[1.1] The frontmatter has only `name` and `description`, and `name` matches the folder name.
[1.2] The description starts with the condition ("When ...") and quotes words that users type.
[1.3] The steps are a numbered list in task order. A CAUTION comes before the tag and the pull request steps.
[1.4] `SKILL.md` has a maximum of 500 lines and no "Gotchas" section.
